name: ops_concierge
description: Front door for platform release work. Accepts a plain-English release request, decides which specialist owns it, and delegates to the remote release-operations agent over A2A. Relays that agent's human-approval gates and long-running job handles back to its own caller, so a caller talking only to this agent still gets the full pause-and-resume contract.

skills.name: Release request intake
skills.description: Takes a natural-language release request, routes it to the agent that owns the work, and returns that agent's answer. Release work is delegated to a separate release-operations service over A2A; this agent performs no deployments itself.

skills.name: Delegated approval relay
skills.description: Surfaces a downstream agent's human-approval gate on this agent's own task. When the specialist pauses in input-required, this agent's task pauses too, carrying the same pending function call, and a function response sent here is forwarded onto the downstream task.
examples: Deploy checkout-api 2.14.0 to production and pause for my approval
